label: US-12CFR1002-RegB-1977 Supplement I, Section 1002.12—Record Retention

obligations.text: If the transaction is subject to § 1002.13 or the creditor is collecting information pursuant to § 1002.5(a)(4), however, the creditor is required to enter and retain the data on personal characteristics in order to comply with the requirements of that section.

Creditors are required to retain information about the scope of the self-test, the methodology used and time period covered by the self-test, the report or results of the self-test including any analysis or conclusions, and any corrective action taken in response to the self-test. 12(b)(7) Preapplication Marketing Information
A creditor must retain the list of criteria used to select potential recipients.
